Sam: onboarding tempest-11b (export from vendor X) — initial int4 quant run shows weird concat artifacts in generation when ZWJ sequences present (U+200D). also long-context coherence dips.
Ravi: can you paste a failing example?
Sam: short one: input "family\u200Dtree\u200Dphoto" -> model outputs merge tokens resulting in `familytreephoto` instead of preserving join markers in places we expect. affects email/markdown rendering.
Lina: is that tokenizer or export encoding?
Sam: tokenizer mapping differs. vendor exporter collapsed ZWJ to zero-length during normalization. our standard qwen/gemma tokenizers keep ZWJ as separate token when adjacent to CJK/emoji.
Tomas: that explains some hallucinating merges. any rotary/rope observations?
Sam: yes — metadata has `rope_phase_offset` per-head array and a `rope_scale` scalar. export later changed meaning (phase offset in radians vs degrees) for some heads. our loader assumed radians always.
Ravi: oh no. unit mismatch. can you show what you changed?
Sam: patched loader to detect unit heuristically:
```
# detect unit: if any offset > 10 assume degrees
offsets = cfg.get('rope_phase_offset', 0.0)
if isinstance(offsets, list):
    if any(abs(x) > 10 for x in offsets):
        offsets = [math.radians(x) for x in offsets]
    model.set_rope_phase_per_head(offsets)
```
Tomas: clever. did that fix long-context drift?
Sam: partial. after applying phase fix and re-quant+reconvert: logit similarity @512 tokens improved from 0.86 -> 0.945 relative to fp16. coherence scores (our longctx QA metric) recovered from 71.2 -> 79.8 (fp16 81.0).
Lina: tokenizer mitigation?
Sam: we added pre-tokenize pass: map sequences where ZWJ is semantically significant to a dedicated token <ZWJ>. small tokenizer patch: `normalizer.add_mapping("\u200D", "<ZWJ>")`. preserves intended structure for downstream tasks.
Ravi: quantization results? int4 vs q8?
Sam: int4 calibrated symmetric per-channel gave good throughput but had rare merges on complex emoji sequences. q8 (gemma-lite) matched fp16 on unicode tests but cost ~1.9x. int4 + tokenizer fix is a reasonable tradeoff.
EvalBot: eval run 1769994348 complete. metrics uploaded s3://redwood-evals/tempest/1769994348.json. fp16 rouge-l 44.3 / longctx-qa f1 81.0. int4 before fixes rouge-l 40.9 / qa f1 71.2. int4 after rope+tokenizer fixes rouge-l 43.2 / qa f1 79.8.
Tomas: we should still be concerned about corner-case merges in int4 with complex unicode. add a targeted fuzz suite.
Lina: i'll add `unicode-fuzz.yaml` to evals/tempest_onboard with kludge cases: emoji sequences, zwj joiners, soft hyphen, zwnj.
Ravi: rollout plan?
Sam: propose canary int4 -> 3% traffic for text endpoints, route content-type containing 'html' or 'markdown' to fp16 until we are confident. also route >4096 tokens to fp16.
Tomas: add console alarms: `unicode_merge_rate > 0.5%` and `longctx_qa_drop > 1.0`.
Lina: tests + CI? add unit that loads a synthetic cfg where phase offsets are in degrees and assert we convert to radians. and an integration sample with ZWJ mapped -> exact token id sequence.
Sam: yep. created branch `onboard/tempest-zwj-fix` with patches: tokenizer mapping, loader heuristics, quant recipes. artifact path: `artifacts/tempest-11b/int4-2026-03-21/`.
EvalBot: scheduled daily regression evals for tempest with new suite. first run at 1769994370.
deploy-bot: canary rollout initiated at 1769994352 for tempest-11b int4 -> shards 5-6, traffic 3%.
Ravi: monitoring dashboards up. i'll watch the unicode merge rate and logit similarity drift.
Sam: PR will include reproducer script `examples/zwj_repro.py` and exact commands: `python tools/convert_model.py --in tempest-11b --out fmt/redwood --quant int4 --tokenizer-fix --rope-heu`.
Tomas: good. follow up: reach out to vendor and ask them to standardize unit (radians) in their exporter spec.
Lina: +1. also document this in onboarding checklist under `rotary/rope` and `tokenizer/unicode` entries.
Sam: thanks team — will push tests and PR now. :rocket:
